evidence.title: GitHub - petergyang/no-ai-slop: Removes 20+ patterns of AI slop from any piece of writing.

name: No AI Slop
summary: Agent skill that removes 20+ AI writing patterns from drafts while keeping the writer's voice, or flags them without rewriting.
description: A SKILL.md package for coding agents with two modes: edit — make the minimum effective edit and return the draft with a "What changed" section; detect — name each slop pattern found, quote the line and give a short fix without scoring the draft or guessing whether AI wrote it. It catches binary contrasts, throat-clearing openers, faux-insight setups, colon reveals, dramatic fragments, importance puffery, weasel attribution and synonym cycling, and checks the fundamentals: lead with the point, active voice, concrete detail.
contains: 20+ ai slop patterns incl. binary contrasts, throat-clearing openers, dramatic fragments
edit mode returns the draft plus a What changed section
detect mode quotes each pattern found without rewriting
can also generate slop as satire
installs with npx skills add petergyang/no-ai-slop; also a ChatGPT plugin
20.2K installs on skills.sh, repo 12.2k stars, MIT
